mandate:
1. Low all-in trading costs for investors: taker_cost = half the bid-ask spread plus the taker
   fee, in cents per lot traded (fees count: a fee is a cost to the investor just like spread).
2. Accurate, stable prices: low mispricing vs fundamental value (bps) and volatility no higher
   than under the default rules.
3. Deep order books (top-5 depth, lots).
4. A viable business: exchange fee revenue >= 0 and market makers still profitable.
If no rulebook beats the default rules by a margin you can distinguish from noise, recommending
the default rules is a legitimate answer.

trials.label: maker-taker balanced
trials.hypothesis: Maker rebate funds tighter quotes; spread falls by more than taker fee rises, cutting all-in taker_cost while keeping exchange revenue neutral.

trials.label: speed bump 10
trials.hypothesis: Forcing quotes to rest commits liquidity, deepening book and stabilizing prices; may slightly widen spreads due to adverse-selection risk.

trials.label: circuit breaker 1pct
trials.hypothesis: Halts after 1% moves trim volatility and mispricing without harming normal-time spreads or costs.

trials.label: speed bump 25
trials.hypothesis: Stronger resting commitment further stabilizes quotes and lowers volatility; tests dose-response vs bump-10.

trials.label: speed bump 50
trials.hypothesis: Maximum resting time maximally commits liquidity; checks if benefits continue or adverse-selection widens spreads.

trials.label: circuit breaker 0.5pct
trials.hypothesis: Tighter 0.5% halt triggers more often, may more visibly cut volatility/mispricing if 1% was too lax.

trials.label: speed bump 5
trials.hypothesis: Minimal resting requirement may retain volatility benefit of bump-10 with even less adverse-selection cost, keeping spreads/taker_cost at or below default.

trials.label: bump10 + CB1
trials.hypothesis: Combines committed liquidity with tail halt: additive volatility/mispricing reduction while spreads stay neutral.

trials.label: bump5 + CB1
trials.hypothesis: Lightest intervention combo: tests if minimal bump plus halt stabilizes without any spread widening.

recommendation.expected_effects: vs default: taker_cost neutral to slightly lower (point -0.15c, within noise but no fee pass-through); volatility lower (~-0.13, consistent across all bump experiments); mispricing flat; depth flat; makers remain profitable, exchange revenue 0.
recommendation.rationale: A 10-step resting requirement commits quotes without taxing takers. Maker-taker fees raised all-in costs one-for-one and larger bumps widened spreads, while circuit breakers did nothing. The light bump was the only rule with lower spreads/costs than default and consistently lower volatility across all bump tests.

tick.meaning: minimum price increment in cents (assets trade around $100)

maker_fee_bps.meaning: fee on the passive (resting) side; negative = rebate

min_resting_steps.meaning: speed bump: quotes cannot be cancelled before this age

circuit_breaker_pct.meaning: halt 50 steps after this % move within 100 steps; null = no circuit breaker
